name: e-Shram National Database for Unorganised Workers
administeringBody: Ministry of Labour and Employment, Govt. of India
coverage: Accidental Death & Permanent Disability cover of ₹2 Lakhs, Partial Disability cover of ₹1 Lakh through PMSBY, and direct linkage to social welfare schemes.

criteria: Must be an unorganised or platform gig worker
Must not be an active member of EPFO (Provident Fund) or ESIC
Must not be an income tax payer

verificationCheck: UAN (Universal Account Number) card generated immediately upon Aadhaar OTP verification.

name: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (PM-JAY)
administeringBody: National Health Authority (NHA), Govt. of India
coverage: Cashless hospitalization health coverage up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year across 27,000+ empanelled government and private hospitals.

criteria: Identified under SECC 2011 deprivation criteria or linked state health cards
Includes occupational categories: driver, conductor, helper, rickshaw puller, delivery provider, manual worker, construction laborer

verificationCheck: Check family name on mera.pmjay.gov.in or nearest Ayushman Mitra kiosk at any district hospital.

name: Rajasthan Platform Based Gig Workers (Registration and Welfare) Act
coverage: Dedicated Social Security Fund financed by a fee on every gig platform transaction (1-2%). Provides accidental insurance, health benefits, retirement fund, and legal grievance redressal.

criteria: Operating as a platform-based gig worker within the state of Rajasthan
Aggregators must register every worker with the welfare board upon onboard

verificationCheck: Unique Gig Worker ID issued by the Department of Labour, Govt. of Rajasthan.

name: Karnataka Platform-Based Gig Workers Social Security and Welfare Scheme
administeringBody: Karnataka State Gig Workers Welfare Board
coverage: ₹4,00,000 insurance package (₹2 Lakh accidental cover + ₹2 Lakh hospitalisation/health coverage). Aggregators pay social security cess. Mandatory 14-day notice before platform deactivation.

criteria: Working in Karnataka on digital platforms
Registered on Karnataka State Seva Sindhu or Labour Portal

documentsRequired: Partner App Profile screenshot showing active status
verificationCheck: Seva Sindhu acknowledgement number and State Gig ID.

name: Pradhan Mantri Shram Yogi Maan-dhan (PM-SYM)
administeringBody: Ministry of Labour & Employment, LIC of India
coverage: Guaranteed minimum monthly pension of ₹3,000 after attaining 60 years of age, with 50% family pension upon death.

criteria: Must not be covered under NPS, ESIC, or EPFO
Must not be an income tax assessee

documentsRequired: Savings Bank Account / Jan Dhan Account with IFSC
verificationCheck: PM-SYM Pension Card issued by nearest Common Service Centre (CSC).
